translations.web: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
translations.bsb: When men are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then He will save the lowly.
translations.kjv: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
translations.asv: When they cast thee down, thou shalt say, There is lifting up; And the humble person he will save.
